notes.notes: [h3]● Battle Balance Adjustments[/h3][p]・Adjusted enemy stats[/p][p]・Enemies now have a small chance to drop money or items upon defeat[/p][p]・Adjusted item stats, mainly for armor[/p][p][/p][h3]● Hamster Puzzle Adjustments[/h3][p]・Increased the time it takes for hamsters to pass through panels[/p][p][/p][h3]● Other Minor Adjustments[/h3][p]・Fixed and refined some dialogue and minor details[/p][p][/p][p][b]Note:[/b] Due to adjustments made to the sewer map, some existing save data may not work correctly.[/p][p]We kindly ask you to continue from an earlier save file if you encounter any issues.[/p]
